title: Grateful Dead Live at Club Melk Weg on 1981-10-15
lineage: MAC > Sony TC-KA3ES > Sound Devices USB Pre-2 > WAV 2496. Edits: WAV 2496 > Wavelab > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2496 tagged. Concert recording & transfer by Richie Stankiewicz, edits by Andrew F. 11/2013.
source: AUD: 2x Beyer M-88 > Sony TC-D5, set up on rail of the mezzanine.

ai_review.summary: Rare first performance of Spoonful shines, but the noisy audience makes the recording difficult to enjoy.
ai_review.review: The show is notable for featuring Spoonful for the first time, a highlight that many fans appreciate. However, the recording captures a bar‑like ambience with loud crowd chatter that drowns out the music, especially during Spoonful, resulting in a mixed listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split: one praises the rare Spoonful performance (4★), another complains about noisy recording (2★), and a neutral comment gives an average rating (3★). The show has a unique highlight but suffers from poor audio clarity, leading to a moderate overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy crowd noise and chatter make it hard to hear the music, especially during Spoonful; sounds more like a noisy New York bar than a clean soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing or flow; the only noted highlight is the debut of Spoonful.
